title: NYC Vintage Subway Token Golf Ball Marker Set
body: Beyond being a perfect substitute for a ball marker, NYC Subway tokens are such a great symbol of NYC -combining ingenuity and practicality. First introduced in 1953 the tokens were then redesigned through the years as either the price of a fare went up or the city wanted to commemorate a milestone with a limited edition token. Every historical design is featured in this collection - from a few of the very first tokens of the 50s/60s, the "bull's eye" look of the 1980s, the pentagon-cut variant in the '90s as well as the celebratory limited edition token released in 1979. Circa - 1952-1995 Two coins per set Protective Linen drawstring bag with NY branches print — Gumtree Golf and Nature Club will contribute 2% of your purchase to help remove CO₂ from the atmosphere.

title: Vintage New York State Outdoor License – Ball Markers
body: New York was one of the first states in the U.S. to formalize wildlife conservation . By the late 19th century, over-hunting and unregulated fishing had pushed many species toward collapse. In response the state created what became the New York State Conservation Department in 1911 and from the late 1920s through the early 1940s they issued these metal license pins to residents who hunted, fished, and trapped its public lands and waters. Each year brought a new color. Each button carried a serial number. Each one was worn openly, pinned to a jacket, a wool coat, a shirt pocket. Proof that you belonged out there and that you agreed to take care of what you touched. These are each a rare piece of New York nature and outdoor history, representing the birth of regulated outdoor recreation. Each piece has been altered to lay flat as a ball marker and features GGNC hand stamped on the reverse side. Comes in a Nature Club dust pouch. Approximately 1.75” in diameter. PLEASE NOTE: These products have been well-loved and hand-picked from across America.
